Blueface, Whose Real Name Is Johnathan Jamall Porter, Is An American Rapper, Songwriter, And Internet Personality From Los Angeles, California. Born On January 20, 1997, Blueface First Rose To Fame In 2018 After His Hit Song “Respect My Cryppin’” Went Viral Due To His Unique Offbeat Rapping Style And Larger-Than-Life Personality. He Later Became A Household Name With His Breakout Hit “Thotiana,” Which Reached The Billboard Hot 100 Top 10 And Featured Remixes With Cardi B And YG. 🔥💙
Outside Of Music, Blueface Has Become One Of The Most Talked-About Personalities On Social Media Due To His Relationships, Family Drama, Viral Moments, And Recent Move Into Livestreaming. His Complicated Relationships With Jaidyn Alexis, Chrisean Rock, And Nevaeh Have Frequently Made Headlines, With Fans Closely Following His Personal Life.
Blueface Shares Two Children, Javaughn And Journey, With His Longtime On-And-Off Partner Jaidyn Alexis. He Also Shares A Son, Chrisean Jesus Malone Jr., With Chrisean Rock, And Has Welcomed Another Son With Nevaeh. His Relationships With All Three Women Have Sparked Plenty Of Online Conversations, Especially As Fans Speculate About Who He Might Eventually Settle Down With.
